inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: One caregiver's record lacked documentation of CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection was conducted 8/2025. You must have a fire inspection at least every 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's record lacked a health statement. Two children's records lacked an immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One caregiver supervising a group of children did not have documentation of current pediatric first aid with rescue breathing on file for review by Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's record lacked their date of admission. Two children's records lacked the complete address of their designated contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The operation did not have attendance records or time sheets for review listing all days and hours worked for the director for the past three months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The operational policies were evaluated and lacked written procedures for for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs. The policy must address the requirements outlined in ?746.2202 of this chapter (relating to What are my responsibilities when planning activities for a child in care with special care needs?).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Records were not available for review for one volunteer who is not counted in ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: During inspection it was determined that the owner is residing at the operation on the weekends which is a violation of Human Resource Code 42.002(7).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver lacked documentation of completion of 16 hours annual training to complete last years annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: One caregiver lacked documentation of completion of 24 hour pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A sampling of children records were evaluated. Two children did not have a current health statement. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete. Two children did not have documentation of a current vision and hearing screening.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: One caregivers record lacked a copy of their photo ID and a copy of the Pre-Employment Affidavit for Applicants for Employment at Certain Child Care Operations (Form 2912).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current health inspection on file for review by Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required: This standard was reviewed on 2/21/2024 as a follow-up to a previous inspection and found deficient. The playground only has one exit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required (26 TAC §746.4307)

occurrences.finding: Firearms, Hunting Knives, Bows and Arrows, Weapons Prohibited Unless Residence: An employee was observed carrying a handgun in a gun holster on his person while at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Firearms, Hunting Knives, Bows and Arrows, Weapons Prohibited Unless Residence (26 TAC §746.3707(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: A sampling of children records were evaluated. Two children's immunization records were observed incomplete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required: The playground only has one exit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required (26 TAC §746.4307)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: The operation did not have documentation of proof of current liability insurance on file for review by Licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Firearms, Hunting Knives, Bows and Arrows, Weapons Prohibited Unless Residence: An employee was observed carrying a handgun in a gun holster on his person while at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Firearms, Hunting Knives, Bows and Arrows, Weapons Prohibited Unless Residence (26 TAC §746.3707(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A sampling of children records were evaluated. Two children's record's lacked their date of admission. One child's record lacked the address of their designated contact. One child's record lacked info regarding whether or not the parents received a copy of the parent handbook. One child's record lacked a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two caregivers records lacked documentation of completion of pediatric first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One caregiver's record lacked documentation of completion of current CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.original_code: HRC42.048(b) - AP Restrictions on the Li
occurrences.finding: HRC42.048(b) - AP Restrictions on the License (Type of Children, Age Range): The operation was providing services to infants at inspection which is not authorized by the permit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.048(b) - AP Restrictions on the License (Type of Children, Age Range) (26 TAC §HRC42.048(b) - AP Restrictions on the Li)

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner: A soiled diaper/pull up was observed in a trash can inn one of the restrooms that did not have a lid. The soiled diaper/pull up was not in a sealed plastic bag.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3505(f))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: A sampling of personnel records were evaluated. Three employee records lacked their date of hire. Three employee records lacked documentation showing the age qualification. Three employee records lacked a notarized affidavit. Three employee records lacked a copy of their photo ID.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver whose presence at the operation is on a provisional basis and must never be left in charge of a group of children was observed working in a classroom alone with and in charge of a group of children. This was corrected at inspection as another staff member went into the classroom with the staff member.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation did not have documentation of a fire drill, carbon monoxide check, smoke detector checks, nor fire extinguisher check for the month of February 2023.[
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - May Rotate if Keep Record of Dates Menus Used: The snack menu did not have documentation for which date it is used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - May Rotate if Keep Record of Dates Menus Used (26 TAC §746.3313(2))

occurrences.finding: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Statement on Enrollment Agreement: The enrollment agreement did not have the following information nor an addendum containing the following information: 1) Is choosing to provide the child's lunch from home; and  (2) Understands the child-care center is not responsible for its nutritional value or for meeting the child's daily food needs during lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Statement on Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.3309(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The Emergency Preparedness Plan was evaluated and lacked the following: 1) An emergency evacuation and relocation diagram; 2) The emergency telephone number that is on file with us; and 3) How you will communicate with local authorities (such as fire, law enforcement, emergency medical services, health department), parents and us; 4) How your staff will continue to care for the children until each child has been released; and 5) How you will reunify the children with their parents as the evacuation, relocation, or sheltering/lock-down is lifted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a health inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Personnel Policies: The operation did not have written personnel policies, including job descriptions, job responsibilities, and requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Personnel Policies (26 TAC §746.201(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedure for Parent Review of Policies: The operational policies were evaluated and lacked the following written procedures: 1) Procedures for parents to review and discuss with the child-care center director any questions or concerns about the policies and procedures of the child-care center; 2) Procedures for parents to participate in the child-care center's operation and activities; 3) how parents may access the HHSC website (www.hhs.texas.gov); Information on vaccine-preventable diseases for employees; 4) water activities;  5) Iinform the parents that: (1) They may visit the child-care center at any time during your hours of operation to observe their child, the program activities, the building, the premises, and the equipment without having to secure prior approval.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit lacked a thermometer and cotton balls.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: One employee did not have documentation of orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))
